name: SectionPanel
intent: A titled dashboard section container: an icon + title + count header with an optional right-aligned action, over a body that can be capped to a fixed pixel height and scroll internally. Compose it with Item rows for a compact, count-stable list (the 'assigned to you' pattern) or with cards — the panel's footprint stays constant no matter how many rows it holds.
when: A dashboard area needs a titled, bordered container with a count and optional action
A list whose length varies and must NOT change the page height — the body scrolls inside a fixed height
Grouping several compact rows (Item) or small cards under one labelled section
whenNot: A single key metric tile -> use MetricCard
A responsive grid of metric tiles -> use KPISummary
A tabular, sortable, selectable record set -> use DataTable

chooseOver.component: A hand-rolled Card with a custom header + overflow div
chooseOver.because: SectionPanel owns the header (icon/title/count/action) and the fixed-height internal scroll so callers just pass rows.

count.note: Count badge next to the title.

height.note: Fixed body height in px; when set the body scrolls internally.

empty.note: Rendered when there are no children.

children.note: Rows or cards to render in the body.

dataContract.note: Presentational and stateless — the caller supplies the header metadata and the body content.

states.default: Header (icon + title + count + action) over a body sized to its content.
states.scroll: With `height` set, the body scrolls internally and the panel's footprint stays fixed.
states.empty: With no children, the `empty` slot renders in the body.

allowedPlacement: a section of a dashboard content region
a column in a multi-panel dashboard grid

lineage.authoredBy: Extracted from the Timesheet summary sections (2026-07-13)
